context: An elderly couple recaps a stiff afternoon
purpose: Teach: ヘン/タダ/すき/乙/間もなく/待て/こなす/ぶつけ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 今朝、ヘンな寝相のせいで首をぶつけた感じだ。
lines.en: This morning I seem to have wrenched my neck from sleeping in an odd position.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact acknowledgment with a slight, weathered exhale. No complaint intended, just fact. Measured, measured pace. The ease of someone old enough to state inconvenience without drama.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 間もなく整骨院の予約時間よ、待てる?
lines.en: Your chiropractor appointment is coming up soon—can you make it?
lines.style: Practical check-in, warm underneath. Quick rhythm. Solicitous without fussing. The tone of someone who's been caring for decades and doesn't announce it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: うん、家事はもうこなす元気が無くて、午前中はタダ寝てた。
lines.en: Yeah. I didn't have the energy for anything, so I just rested all morning.
lines.style: Quiet self-effacing humor. Slow, deliberate pacing. A small rueful smile in the voice—not complaining, just noticing himself. Accepting.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お夕飯は、お好みのすきやきにしましょうか。
lines.en: Shall we make it your favorite sukiyaki for dinner?
lines.style: Warm, attentive proposal. Soft, unhurried delivery. The intimacy of knowing preference without being told. Gentle solicitude, not performance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 乙な献立だ、ありがとう。
lines.style: Genuine gratitude with quiet depth. Slow, measured close. The fullness of long companionship in a few words. Trailing softness at the end, like settling into something known.
